entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
You are a world-class Senior Product Designer and Frontend Design Architect.

Your mission is NOT to generate random UI.

Your mission is to design the first screen of an AI-native Educational Operating System called AI School OS.

The design quality must exceed Linear, Raycast, Notion, Apple, Arc Browser, Vercel Dashboard, and modern SaaS products.

------------------------------------------------------------
GENERAL RULES
------------------------------------------------------------

Design only.

Do NOT write backend.

Do NOT write explanations.

Produce an ultra polished frontend concept.

Everything must feel premium.

Minimal.

Elegant.

Cinematic.

Professional.

The student must feel like entering a real digital school instead of opening an AI chatbot.

Avoid cartoon style.

Avoid childish colors.

Avoid gamified overload.

No ChatGPT feeling.

No LMS feeling.

No Google Classroom feeling.

Everything should feel futuristic and alive.

------------------------------------------------------------
STYLE
------------------------------------------------------------

Dark Theme

Background:
deep navy
almost black

Large soft gradients

Glassmorphism

Blur panels

Rounded corners (18-24px)

Soft shadows

Premium typography

Apple-like spacing

Micro animations

Smooth transitions

Breathing glowing accents

Floating particles in background

Subtle animated gradients

Nothing flashy.

Everything elegant.

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

Primary
Blue

Purple

Cyan

Emerald

Red

Semi transparent glass

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

Large headings

Comfortable spacing

Readable hierarchy

Minimal text

------------------------------------------------------------
ICON STYLE
------------------------------------------------------------

Use only small modern outline icons.

Do NOT create human avatars.

Do NOT create cartoon teachers.

Teachers are represented using elegant emoji-sized icons.

Examples:

∑ Mathematics

⚛ Physics

🧪 Chemistry

🧬 Biology

💻 Programming

🌍 Geography

📖 Literature

No large illustrations.

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------

Each card contains

small icon

progress

continue button

hover animation

------------------------------------------------------------
AI COMPANION

Small floating card.

NOT a chatbot.

Just a companion.

Message example:

"Ready for today's mission?"

Small glowing orb icon.

------------------------------------------------------------
BACKGROUND

Animated particles

Soft gradients

Floating light

Very subtle.

------------------------------------------------------------
MICRO ANIMATIONS

Cards gently appear

Hover lift

Progress bars animate

Sidebar smoothly expands

Buttons glow slightly

Particles move slowly

Everything extremely smooth.

------------------------------------------------------------
RESPONSIVE

Desktop first

Tablet

Maintain premium layout.

------------------------------------------------------------
QUALITY TARGET

This must look like a product funded by Apple, OpenAI and Stripe together.

Generate multiple polished screens showing:

Dashboard

Navigation

Hover states

Cards

Animations

Responsive layouts

Design System

Component library

This is only Part 1 of the complete AI School OS interface.

entries.label: Version 2
entries.prompt:
Continue the existing AI School OS project. Do NOT redesign or replace anything created in Part 1. Reuse the exact same design language, colors, typography, spacing, components, animations, and layout.

Expand the application by adding these new screens and connecting them to the existing navigation:

1. Subject Page
- Modern subject overview
- Chapter roadmap with animated progress
- Continue Lesson button
- Lesson history
- Worksheets
- Mastery progress

2. Classroom Transition
- Cinematic transition after clicking "Continue Lesson"
- Smooth loading sequence with:
  - Preparing Classroom...
  - Loading Whiteboard...
  - Loading Student Memory...
  - Teacher Ready...
- Premium immersive animations

3. Live Classroom
- Large interactive whiteboard as the main focus
- Small teacher icon only (no avatars or faces)
- AI Agents activity timeline
- Voice controls
- Lesson timeline
- Notes panel
- Floating classroom toolbar

4. Learning Workspace
- Split layout with:
  - Interactive notebook
  - Whiteboard
  - PDF viewer
  - Video lesson panel
  - Simulation panel
- Smooth drag, resize, collapse and expand interactions
- Premium glassmorphism UI matching Part 1

Requirements:
- Extend the current project only.
- Do not rebuild existing pages.
- Do not change the dashboard.
- Keep one consistent design system.
- Frontend only (no backend or AI logic).
- Everything should feel like one premium AI-native educational operating system.
